description: Opus CC verify-library-turns: library coaching-panda (Rillaboom + Kingambit lead, Sneasler + Baxcalibur back) vs library psy-sand-udon (Armarouge + Indeedee-F lead, Salamence + Sneasler back), VGC Reg M-C (team preview keeps 4), both teams' published sets referenced from teams/library. Start: Grassy Surge, then Indeedee-F's Psychic Surge replaces it. Turn 1: Armarouge's Expanding Force (spread in Psychic Terrain; Kingambit is immune) hits Rillaboom; Indeedee-F's Follow Me draws Rillaboom's High Horsepower and Kingambit's Kowtow Cleave (Black Glasses) aimed at Armarouge (Focus Sash, Weak Armor) into itself (Colbur Berry). Speeds 127 / 123 / 105 / 71: no ties.
